items.title: Sonny Rollins — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Babs would get a job, and he was good at getting these gigs, and he’d have all these guys–Dexter Gordon, and uh, Fats Navarro, and Wardell Gray and, you know uh, all these people of the period, and the real guys–giants–who were playing this music. So, I got a chance, he would get me on these gigs.

ctx.x: I assume it was with the vocalist...who was...?
